title: Meaning on the platform
sub: Film 3 of 6 of Governance you can use: one meaning on the platform. Each term has one page, every copy is checked against it each night, a number in a meaning is kept as one setting, and a count is defined once, for people, reports and agents.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side. The meanings of award keep their colours: violet for the glossary's words, rose for the old words, olive for degrees only. A copy in step with its home has a violet thread to it, and one that's behind turns rose. The platform's pages are drawn as forms; files are paper sheets, copied from the example project. The count, defined once, is a ledger with its rule at the top.
